How to use

  • One drop. This is the most concentrated material in the range.
  • Dilute to 0.5% or less for a facial oil.
  • Blend a single drop into sandalwood or jojoba and nothing else.

Dilute before applying to skin and patch-test first. Not for internal use.

Who it's for

One special bottle

Almost nobody buys rose as an everyday oil. It is bought for an occasion, or as a gift.

Serious blenders

A heart note nothing else substitutes for, used a drop at a time.

Facial oils at very low dilution

Long used in skincare, though at 0.5% or below rather than anything higher.

What people get wrong

Comparing it to rose scent you already know. Soap, candle and most perfume rose is synthetic, built mostly from a handful of compounds. The real thing is darker, greener and far less sweet, and people are often surprised rather than delighted on first smell.

Using more than a drop. It is the most concentrated thing we sell, and a second drop does not double the effect — it buries whatever else was in the blend.

What it won't do

An absolute, so solvent extracted. Rose otto, the steam-distilled version, smells lighter and costs more again; if you specifically want otto, this is not it.

We are not going to pretend the price is anything other than what it is. Roughly three thousand rose petals go into a single gram.

We describe how our oils smell and how people use them. We don't make medical claims, because essential oils aren't medicine.

Questions about Rose Absolute

What is the difference between rose absolute and rose otto?

Extraction. Otto is steam distilled and smells lighter, fresher and more lemony. Absolute is solvent extracted, keeps more of the deep honeyed character, and gives a higher yield — which is why otto costs even more than this does.

Why is real rose so expensive?

Yield. It takes several thousand hand-picked petals to produce one gram of absolute, and they have to be picked at dawn and processed within hours. No amount of efficiency changes that arithmetic.

Is this Kannauj rose?

It comes through our Kannauj supply chain, which has distilled roses for centuries. Ask us about a specific batch and we will tell you what we hold on it.

How long does it keep once opened?

Two to three years stored properly — cool, dark and tightly closed. Distilled oils keep considerably better than cold-pressed citrus.

What dilution should I use on skin?

Lower than most. An absolute, not an essential oil — solvent extracted, so trace residue is inherent to the process. Avoid during pregnancy. For general use, dilute into a carrier oil such as jojoba and patch-test on a small area first.

Can I take it internally?

No. None of our oils are food grade and none are sold for internal use. Essential oils are extremely concentrated, and advice to add them to water or food is not advice we endorse.

How quickly will it arrive?

Orders are dispatched from Delhi within two business days and usually arrive within a further three to five, depending on where you are. Shipping is free over ₹999.
